Name: Northern Heart Melon - A custom crop
Author: voidcultist666
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/void-cultist/NorthernHeartMelon/refs/heads/main/Images/NorthernHeartMelonBanner.png[/img]

[line]
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]What does this mod do?[/b][/size][/font][/center][center][font=Trebuchet MS]This mod adds the new custom crop [b]Northern Heart Melon[/b]. It is a mod that was made as companion mod to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39402]NPC Pei Ming[/url]﻿ but can also be used as a standalone. In addition to the crop itself, this mod adds the following recipes and goods:

[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS][/font][quote][font=Trebuchet MS]Glazed Heart Melon[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Love Tea[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Giftable Tassel (exclusive to NPC Pei Ming)[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS](Equippable) Tassel[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Heart Melon Huangjiu[/font][/quote][font=Trebuchet MS][/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]
More following in the future!
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4]
If you use this mod in combination with the NPC Pei Ming, it changes the way the recipes are obtained. [/size][b][size=4]It is mandatory for this mod to be installed to use with Pei Ming as the items provided tie in to his storyline progression![/size]
[/b][/font][/center]
[line]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][center][size=5]﻿Config Options[/size][font=Trebuchet MS]

The config options let you change the prices of the various items. These options can be accessed using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or by [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Configure_mods]editing the config.json[/url] that will be created upon launching the game with the mod installed for the first time[/font][font=Trebuchet MS].[/font][/center][/b][/font]
[line]
[center]﻿[/center][center][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
After downloading the zip file, unpack it and [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods]move its contents into your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/url]﻿. Make sure that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are installed and up to date.[/font][/center]
[line]
[b][size=5][center][font=Trebuchet MS]Using any components of this mod for AI training or in generative AI works is strictly prohibited. This rule also applies to translations - do not translate this mod using genAI. 

[line]
[url=https://github.com/void-cultist/NorthernHeartMelon/blob/main/README.md]Code and detailed information on Github[/url]﻿

[/font][/center][/size][/b]
